answer: A river-quorum bond stops mass fakes. A newcomer posts a 40-credit bond, needing five established neighbors to co-sign; their quill signatures flow to the public record as 20-credit stakes. Any peer may send a fraud tip downstream, opening a dune audit; a hollow shell caves in, burning 140 credits; a co-signing ring backing fakes loses every stake. The kth fake costs 140; 1,000 risk 140,000. An honest agent pays 40 once, refunded in 20 epochs.
